resources.string: Checks the selected GitHub Releases channel once when StackLife first comes to the foreground in a new process. No planner or account data is sent.
Download, verify and install updates, including on mobile data. Android may restart StackLife. If permission or confirmation is needed, continue on this page. Off by default.
Stable checks official releases only. Beta also includes prereleases. Switching channels clears the previous check.
